title: Internal Financial Controls Review — Healthcare Sector
metaTitle: Internal Financial Controls Review Overview | NRSR & Co
metaDesc: An overview of an internal financial controls review carried out for an entity in the healthcare sector.
summary: An internal financial controls review, including SOP documentation, was carried out for a healthcare-sector entity.
challenge: The entity's finance and procurement functions did not have formally documented Standard Operating Procedures, and sought a review of existing internal controls across these functions.
solution: The engagement covered mapping of existing processes, identification of control gaps in the finance and procurement workflows, and preparation of documented Standard Operating Procedures.
execution: Process walkthroughs were conducted with relevant department heads, followed by documentation of revised procedures and a review session to confirm alignment with the entity's operational requirements.
